title: Warm Smoky Moroccan Ground Pork Harira
description: A pungent and pillowy Moroccan dish featuring ground pork, smoky binchotan-charcoal flavor, and a keto-friendly twist, served in a lazy-susan-spinner vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the ground pork, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the binchotan charcoal powder, smoked paprika, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the harira hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Place the harira in a lazy-susan-spinner vessel for a unique and interactive dining experience.
